validity.recommendation: No action beyond the three spec/classification caveats below.
validity.researcher_notes: Existence and classification are well supported by independent sources, not just the sheet's own cited refs. This is Stage 2 of the 4-stage 'Saryarka' national gasification trunk (Kyzylorda-Astana-Kokshetau-Petropavlovsk), documented continuously since 2018 across kapital.kz, neftegaz.ru, KDB, KMG annual reports, EABR financing disclosures, and Kazakhstan's own official gasification-scheme and gas-industry-plan decrees (adilet.zan.kz). Length 276 km and cost 48.2 bn KZT agree to the decimal across THREE independent origins: kapital.kz/74365 (Dec 11 2018, the original 4-stage announcement), kdb.kz/8236 (Oct 10 2019, Kazakhstan Development Bank), and neftegaz.ru's technical-library page 142478 -- high tier. url_verifier's literal-digit miss on kapital.kz/74365 for SegmentCost (48200000000) is a checker artifact: the article states '48,2 млрд тенге' (a prose/unit equivalent), not a wrong value. Diameter 630mm (the sheet's own blacksea-caspia.eu ref, Dec 2019, reporting on Stage 1's commissioning while recapping Stage 2's spec) is plausible but I could NOT independently corroborate it a second time -- a WebSearch snippet appearing to confirm '630 мм' traced to a webpack CSS asset hash on rus.azattyq-ruhy.kz ('critical.186f630b.css'), not article text; I verified this by pulling the raw HTML and grepping for the real string, which found zero occurrences in the body text. Flagging this because it's exactly the kind of false corroboration a less careful pass would have banked -- treat Diameter as single-sourced (medium tier), not doubly confirmed. Classification (PipelineType=transmission) is correct: every source calls this a 'магистральный газопровод' (main/trunk line) feeding an entire oblast, not a gathering/feeder line. FuelSource 'Karachaganak, Tengiz, Kashagan' is directly confirmed by kapital.kz/79860 (reverse-flow via the existing Central Asia-Center system) and applies system-wide across all Saryarka stages including this one. No duplicate concern against the roster: P3308 (Stage 3, Kokshetau->Petropavlovsk, 177km/426mm) and P3309 (Stage 4, capacity-expansion-only, len=0) are genuinely distinct phases of the same project, correctly split into separate PIDs by segment -- not a double-count of P3307's own Astana-Kokshetau stage.

validity.recommendation: Treat ConstructionYear=2028 and StartYear1=2025 as both unresolved rather than presenting either as a real schedule. StartYear1=2025 traces to a completion target stated in the Sept-2023 General Gasification Scheme decree (adilet G23JVM00350, para on 'завершением второго и третьего этапов ... до 2025 года') -- that target has been missed and is obsolete. ConstructionYear=2028 traces to an Aug-2025 provincial (Akmola akimat) statement (24.kz/722962: 'запланировано на 2028 год') -- but that is itself contradicted by the Ministry of Energy's own Vice-Minister eight months later (see status_reviews) saying no route/timing decision has been made at all. Recommend clearing StartYear1 and marking ConstructionYear as a provincial-level target only (not a Ministry-confirmed one), pending the Plan A/Plan B decision described below.
validity.researcher_notes: Traced the date fields to their literal origin and found they splice together TWO different targets from TWO different points in time, which is the actual mechanism behind the Start<Construction contradiction the orchestrator flagged. (1) adilet.zan.kz/G23JVM00350#z250 (Order 350, Sept 29 2023, 'General Gasification Scheme of Kazakhstan 2015-2030') states plainly: '3) завершением второго и третьего этапов строительства магистрального газопровода Сарыарка до 2025 года до городов Кокшетау и Петропавловска' -- i.e. COMPLETION (in-service) by 2025. That is where StartYear1=2025 comes from, and it is a 2023-vintage target that has already been missed (construction hadn't even begun by 2023, let alone finished by 2025). (2) 24.kz/722962 (Aug 5 2025, an Akmola-oblast Q&A) instead says: 'Строительство 2 и 3 этапов ... запланировано на 2028 год' -- CONSTRUCTION planned for 2028, a later, different, and more conservative target. So GEM's row is combining the 2023 completion target with the 2025 construction target for what was originally the SAME slipping schedule -- neither number represents a single coherent current plan. Independently, I found NO evidence either target has been formally adopted government-wide: the June-2025 Комплексный план (adilet P2500000463) lists only Stage 4 (compressor stations, 2027 commissioning, 180.7bn KZT) among 2025-2029 gas-sector investments and does not mention Stage 2/3 pipe construction at all. And as of April 9 2026 (rus.baq.kz), Vice-Minister Sanzhar Zharkeshov told the press 'Пока ничего окончательно не определено' (nothing is definitively decided yet) between two competing solutions for gasifying the north -- see status_reviews for the full Plan A/Plan B picture. Given a live, unresolved policy choice sits upstream of any construction date, I did not fabricate a replacement year; the honest position is that neither 2025 nor 2028 is a safe number to keep as-is.

validity.recommendation: Flag for next year's Update/Discovery pass, do not change FuelSource now: if the 'Ishim-Astana' route becomes the actual vehicle that builds the Astana-Kokshetau-Petropavlovsk corridor, this row's FuelSource (domestic Karachaganak/Tengiz/Kashagan reversal gas) would need to change to imported Russian gas, and Sponsor/financing would need Gazprom added. Also worth a Discovery check: I found no separate GEM entity for an 'Ishim-Astana Gas Pipeline' in the Kazakhstan roster -- it may be an un-tracked project.
validity.researcher_notes: A materially new and very recent development bears directly on what this row even represents going forward. On Feb 11 2026 (kz.kursiv.media), Kazakhstan's Vice-Minister of Energy Kayyrkhan Tutkyshbaev told the Mazhilis (parliament) on the record: 'Второе решение — мы с российской стороной с 2027 по 2030 годы будем реализовывать проект Ишим-Астана. Будет построен газопровод Астана-Кокшетау-Петропавловск, пустим газ и после обеспечения севера газом, мы рассмотрим соответствующие проектные документы [для газификации восточных областей]' -- i.e. Kazakhstan and Russia will implement the 'Ishim-Astana' project 2027-2030, and an Astana-Kokshetau-Petropavlovsk pipeline WILL be built as part of it, carrying RUSSIAN gas (via the Ishim-Astana import line, launch date Jan 1 2030 per RK ambassador Dauren Abayev, arbatmedia.kz). That is the exact same city-pair corridor as P3307 (Astana-Kokshetau) + P3308 (Kokshetau-Petropavlovsk) combined, but sourced and financed completely differently from the original 2018 'Saryarka Stage 2/3' concept this row describes (domestic gas via reversal flow through Beineu-Bozoy-Shymkent/Central Asia-Center, no Russian involvement). A Gazprom-Kazakhstan memorandum on this was signed Oct 9 2025 (rus.azattyq-ruhy.kz, Jul 1 2026 piece). Two months after the Feb 2026 statement, the picture reads less settled again: on Apr 9 2026 (rus.baq.kz) the Vice-Minister described this as still one of two live options ('план А' = new import line from Russia/Ishim, 'план Б' = expand Saryarka) with 'nothing definitively decided.' And a Mar 15 2025 inform.kz piece ('Дойдет ли газ до Кокшетау') gives an updated combined Stage-2+3 cost of 182.1bn KZT for the domestic option specifically -- suspiciously close to the 180.7bn KZT the June-2025 Комплексный план assigns to 'Stage 4,' raising an open question about whether the government's phase numbering/scope has been reshuffled since the 2018 four-stage plan this row's Length/Cost/Diameter values trace to. I'm not proposing any value change off this -- the domestic option (which is what this row actually records) has not been ruled out -- but this is exactly the kind of thing that could flip FuelSource, ConstructionYear and Sponsor within the next reporting cycle, so it belongs in the row's history.

validity.recommendation: Either re-source Capacity to something that states Stage-2's own throughput, or annotate ResearcherNotes that 2.20 bcm/y is a Stage-1/system-level figure carried across to Stage 2 rather than a confirmed per-segment value. Do not treat the existing ref as segment-specific support.
validity.researcher_notes: The row's cited ref for Capacity (neftegaz.ru/481053, 17 Aug 2019) passed the automated string check ('2,2 млрд м3/год' is present) but I read the full article and it is NOT about Stage 2 at all -- it is entirely about Stage 1 (Kyzylorda-Zhezkazgan-Karaganda-Temirtau-Nur-Sultan, 1,061 km, pipe diameter 820mm, '75% complete' as of Aug 2019). Its '2,2 млрд м3/год' throughput figure is explicitly Stage 1's rated capacity, not a Stage-2-specific number. Given Stage 2's pipe is a smaller 630mm (vs Stage 1's 820mm) and Stage 3 drops further to 426mm -- consistent with gas being progressively drawn off for local consumers along the route -- it is not safe to assume the same 2.2 bcm/y figure carries unchanged all the way to Kokshetau. I searched specifically for a Stage-2 throughput figure (neftegaz.ru/142478 tech-library page, multiple search passes) and found only the SYSTEM-WIDE target of 3 bcm/y achieved after Stage 4's compressor stations are built -- no source states a Stage-2-specific design capacity. Leaving the value as-is (it is plausible and not contradicted) but flagging that its citation is a scope mismatch, not genuine segment-level support.

fills.researcher_notes: kapital.kz/74365 (Dec 11 2018) is the first specific public announcement of the 4-stage Saryarka plan with Stage-2 numbers attached (276km/48.2bn KZT) -- effectively Stage 2's proposal date. Independently, neftegaz.ru/142478 documents that the Ministry of Energy's roadmap for the whole multi-stage project (which explicitly includes Stage 2 Astana-Kokshetau) was approved at a Mar 7 2018 selector meeting with the government and the akimats of the affected regions -- an earlier, independent confirmation that 2018 is the right proposal year.

Delayed=yes is directly reported, not merely inferred from a slipping date -- so DelayType should be 'confirmed', not 'inferred'. ratel.kz's own headline (Dec 19 2023) is literally 'Строительство 2-й и 3-й очереди магистрального газопровода Сарыарка откладывается' (construction of Stages 2 and 3 IS BEING DELAYED), naming the reason (the Beineu-Bozoy-Shymkent line ran at 106% capacity in winter 2022-23, so its second line must be finished first). inform.kz (Feb 12 2024) independently confirms the same prerequisite-driven delay framing two months later. Recommend changing DelayType from 'inferred' to 'confirmed' to match the vocabulary (this is reported fact, not our inference from stale dates).

KazMunayGas's own 2020 annual report states plainly: 'Объекты первого этапа строительства МГ Сарыарка ... находятся в собственности АО АстанаГаз КМГ, акционерами которого являются АО Самрук-Қазына (50%) и АО Baiterek Venture Fund (50%)' -- AstanaGaz KMG owns the Saryarka facilities outright (KMG itself has no direct stake); Samruk-Kazyna/Baiterek own AstanaGaz KMG, one level up the chain, which does not change GEM's Owner1 field. Independently, the Kazakhstan Development Bank's own project page for AstanaGaz KMG (loan project 13881) confirms AstanaGaz KMG as the borrower/project company for the Saryarka pipeline build. Both sources describe Stage 1 specifically (the only stage built so far) -- AstanaGaz KMG is the single project company for the whole 4-stage Saryarka program, so Owner1=100% for the not-yet-built Stage 2 is a reasonable carry-forward, but I could not find a source describing Stage-2 ownership standing on its own (because it doesn't exist yet).

status_reviews.researcher_notes: Walked the whole delay/decision chain forward from the sheet's Aug-2025 evidence to the newest I could find (Jul 2026). Dec 19 2023 (ratel.kz): construction of Stages 2/3 explicitly reported as delayed, pending the Beineu-Bozoy-Shymkent second line (targeted 2026). Feb 12 2024 (inform.kz): same story, still feasibility-stage, 188.5bn KZT combined budget cited, alternative routing under discussion. Mar 15 2025 (inform.kz, 'Дойдет ли газ до Кокшетау'): still no decision -- two live options, domestic Stage 2/3 (now costed at 182.1bn KZT) vs a Russian-gas connection; only ~20,000 apartments in Kokshetau have gas at all. Aug 5 2025 (24.kz, the sheet's own Construction[ref]): Akmola provincial official cites a 2028 construction target for Stages 2/3. Feb 11 2026 (kz.kursiv.media): Vice-Minister Tutkyshbaev tells parliament Kazakhstan will implement 'Ishim-Astana' with Russia 2027-2030 and an Astana-Kokshetau-Petropavlovsk pipe will be built as part of it (see the classification concern in validity). Apr 9 2026 (rus.baq.kz): the SAME Vice-Minister, two months later, describes this as still just one of two undecided options ('Plan A' vs 'Plan B'), 'nothing definitively decided.' Jul 1 2026 (rus.azattyq-ruhy.kz): confirms an Oct 9 2025 Kazakhstan-Gazprom MoU exists for Ishim-Astana, contingent on 'timely financing' and 'successful construction,' with no firm date. Net read: across 2.5+ years of continuous, independently-reported coverage, NOT ONE SPADE has gone into the ground on Stage 2 (Astana-Kokshetau) -- it remains a real, actively-discussed, but entirely unbuilt proposal, with its ultimate implementation vehicle (domestic Saryarka expansion vs Russian-gas Ishim-Astana) still an open question as of the most recent evidence. Status=proposed is therefore still the correct label -- this is NOT a case of silence/no-news (which would trigger the stale->shelved dormancy rule); there is abundant, very recent, dated news, it just all says 'still undecided.' What IS wrong is the specific date fields (ConstructionYear/StartYear1), addressed as a spec concern in validity rather than here, since Status itself is not in question.

summary: Real, correctly-classified Stage 2 of the 4-stage Saryarka trunk (existence/duplicate/classification all clean); staged 3 missing refs (ProposalYear=2018, Delay incl. DelayType inferred->confirmed, Owner=AstanaGaz KMG JSC); flagged as spec concerns: ConstructionYear=2028/StartYear1=2025 splice two different superseded targets from two different years and should be treated as unresolved, Capacity's cited ref actually describes Stage 1 not Stage 2, and a Feb-2026 vice-ministerial statement ties this same Astana-Kokshetau-Petropavlovsk corridor to a new Russian-gas 'Ishim-Astana' project (2027-2030) that could eventually change FuelSource/Sponsor -- still unresolved as of the newest (Apr/Jul 2026) evidence, so Status=proposed is confirmed as-is, not changed.
